children: Bloomia Holdings, Inc. reported full-year 2026 results showing revenue of $48.13M and a net loss, with diluted EPS of ($4.43), versus revenue of $35.62M and diluted EPS of $0.82 in 2025.
¹ Reported as “Revenue, net”. ² Reported as “Net (loss) income attributable to Bloomia Holdings, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue trend: Annual net revenue was $48.13M, up from $35.62M in 2025, driven by a 12% price increase offset by fewer stems sold.
Seasonality & channel mix: Sales remain concentrated in the spring peak (Valentine’s, Easter, Mother’s Day) and through major U.S. mass-market retail partners.

Cost and waste pressures: Margins were pressured by a 21% increase in bulb costs, FX headwinds and over $2.5M of excess crop waste in spring 2026; mitigation efforts include new mite control measures.
Operational investments: The company cultivates about 90M tulip stems annually, has committed roughly $14M in bulb purchases for 2026–27, and deployed new bulb management software.
Geographic and brand position: Bloomia is positioned as a leading U.S. fresh-cut tulip producer with operations and supplier relationships in the Netherlands, South Africa and Chile.
